source: Yahoo Finance 5-minute chart includePrePost (unofficial), paired with SOXX daily OHLCV

methodology.pre_return: last available premarket 5m close / first available premarket 5m open - 1
methodology.pre_dd: minimum observed 5m close / prior max of first open and observed 5m closes - 1
methodology.pre_gap: last available premarket 5m close / previous regular daily close - 1
methodology.pre_range: max premarket 5m high / min premarket 5m low - 1
methodology.pre_5m: [Eastern minute since midnight, observed 5m close / first premarket open - 1 in percent]; available prices only
methodology.pre_high_time: Eastern 5m bar start timestamp with highest observed valid 5m high (first if tied)
methodology.pre_low_time: Eastern 5m bar start timestamp with lowest observed valid 5m low (first if tied)
methodology.intraday_time_research: Only sessions with observed <=04:05 and >=09:20 and >=48 five-minute bars are eligible for high/low time-of-day frequency and normalized mean intraday profile.
methodology.regular_return: regular daily close / same-day regular daily open - 1
methodology.sampling: Only complete regular days with >=4 premarket bars; first bar <=08:30, last bar >=09:15 ET.
methodology.limit: Extended-hours 5m history is limited (~60 days); archive starts with what the provider returns. Sparse trades and price feeds can omit bars.
